questions.question: The selling price of 15 oranges is the same as the cost price of 19 oranges. What is the approximate profit percentage?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

SP of 15 Oranges = CP of 19 Oranges

**Formula used:**

Profit percentage = ((SP-CP))/(CP)×100 

**Calculations:**

According to the question,

SP × 15 = 19 × CP

⇒ 15CP + 15Profit = 19CP 

∵ SP = Profit + CP

Profit = (4)/(15) CP

Now, Profit percentage = (4CP)/(15CP)×100 

= (4)/(15)×100 

= 0.266666.. × 100

= 26.67%

**Hence, The Required value is 26.67%.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__** According to the question,

15 SP = 19 CP

SP/CP = 19/15

Profit = SP - CP = 19 - 15 = 4

Profit % = Profit/CP × 100

⇒ 4/15 × 100 = 26.67%

questions.question: A man buys a toy for Rs. 400 and sells it at a loss of 15%. What is the selling price of the toy?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

CP of toy Rs.400

Loss = 15%

**Concept used:**

SP = ((100-loss\%))/(100)× CP

**Calculation:**

SP = ((100-loss\%))/(100)× CP

SP = ((100-15))/(100)× CP

SP = ((85))/(100)× CP

SP = 0.85 × 400 = 340

**∴ The value of SP is Rs. 340.**

questions.question: A policeman spots a thief at a distance of 200 m and starts chasing him. While the policeman runs at a speed of 9 km/h, the thief runs at a speed of 7 km/h. After how long will the policeman catch the thief?
questions.solution:
Given:

Distance(d) = 200 m

Speed of the policeman(b) = 9 km/h

Speed of the thief(a) = 7 km/h

Formula Used :

(i) Time = d ÷ [(b - a)]

Calculations:

d = 200 m ,

⇒ a = 7 km/h = 7 × 5/18 = 35/18 m/s

⇒ b = 9 km/h = 9 × 5/18 = 5/2 m/s

According to the formula

Time = d ÷ (b - a)

Time = 200 ÷ (5/2 – 35/18)

Time = (200)/(frac{10){18}}

Time = 18 × 20

Time = 360 s = 360/60 = 6 minutes

Hence, The Police will take 6 minutes to catch thief.

questions.question: The average of P1, P2 and P3 is 50. If the value of P1 is half of the average, then what is the average of P2 and P3?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The average of P1 , P2 and P3 is 50,

And P1 is half of the average = 50/2 = 25.

**Formula used:**

Average = Sum of quantities/No. of quantities

**Calculations:**

According to question,

(P1 + P2 + P3)/(3)= 50

⇒ P1 + P2 + P3 = 150

⇒ 25 + P2 + P3 = 150

⇒ P2 + P3 = 125

Now, the average of P2 and P3 is (P2+P3)/(2) = (125)/(2)= 62.5

**Hence, the average of P2 and P3 is 62.5**

questions.question: A camp of soldiers has food for 200 days. After 20 days, 100 more soldiers join the camp and the food now can last for 80 days. What was the initial number of soldiers in the camp?
questions.solution:
Given:

In a soldier camp ration is available for x soldiers for 200 days

After 20 days 100 soldiers joined

Calculation:

Let the initial no. of soldiers be x.

After 20 days :

For 1 soldiers, ration will last (200 - 20) days = 180 days

For x soldiers, the ration will last {180 × (x)} days

Now, 

Number of soldiers = x + 100 

For (x + 100) soldiers, the ration will last for = (180x)/(x + 100)

For (x + 100) soldiers, the ration will last for = (180x)/(x+100)days.

Now, given Time = 80 days

(180x)/(x+100) = 80 

⇒ 80x + 8000 = 180x

⇒ 100x = 8000

Hence, x = 80

∴ Initial Number of soldiers was 80.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__** Calculation:

Let number of soldiers be x.

∴ Total available food = x × 200

Food consumed by x soldiers in 20 days = x × 20

Now, 100 soldiers are added to camp,

∴ New number of soldiers = (x + 100)

Now rest food is finished in 80 days by (x + 100) soldiers

∴ food consumed in 80 days = (x + 100) × 80

According to question -

⇒ 200x = 20x + 80(x + 100)

⇒ 200x = 100x + 8000

⇒ 100x = 8000

x = 80

**∴ Initial number of soldiers are 80. **

questions.question: Two successive discounts of 20% and 30% are given while selling an item. What is the ratio of the marked price to the selling price of the item?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

2 successive discounts of 20% and 30%

**Calculations:**

Let the Marked price be 100.

SP after 1st discount = 100 - 20 = 80

SP after 2nd discount = 80 - 30% of 80 = 80 - 0.3(80)

= 80 - 24 = 56

So, The Ratio

= 100 ∶ 56

= 25 ∶ 14

**∴ The Required ratio is 25 ∶ 14.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__**Formula used:

When 2 successive discounts X and Y are given -

Equivalent discount = (X + Y - XY/100)%

**Calculation:**

X = 20% and Y = 30%

Equivalent discount = [20 + 30 - (20 × 30)/100]%

= 50 - 6

= 44%

Let MP be 100

Then, after 44% discount

SP = 56

∴ MP : SP = 100 : 56

= 25 : 14

∴ **Required ratio is 25 : 14**

questions.question: Find the time taken by a boat to travel 80 km with the current, if the speed of the boat in still water is 14 km/h and the speed of the current is 6 km/h.
questions.solution:
Given:

Speed of a boat in still water = 14 km/h

Distance covered = 80 km 

Speed of the current = 6 km/h

Formulas used:

Speed downstream = Speed of boat + Speed of stream 

Time = Distance/Speed 

Calculation:

Downstream speed = 14 + 6 = 20 km/h

Let the time taken be = t 

80 km/(20) = t

⇒ 4 = t

⇒ t = 4 h

∴ The Time taken by boat to travel 80 km downstream is 4 hours.

questions.solution:

Average of 4 consecutive numbers = 64.5

**Calculations:**

Let the 4 numbers be (a), (a + 1), (a + 2) and (a + 3)

So, the sum of these 4 numbers = 4a + 6 

Now, According to question,

Average = 64.5

⇒ (4a+6)/(4)= 64.5

⇒ 4a + 6 = 258

⇒ a = 252/4

⇒ a = 63

Hence, Largest number = a + 3 = 63 + 3 = 66

**∴ The Largest number is 66.**

questions.question: A certain sum of money amounts to 3 times of itself in 13 years when interest is compounded annually at a certain rate of interest per annum. In how many years will the initial sum amount to 9 times of itself at the same rate of interest per annum, also compounded annually?
questions.solution:
Given:

A certain sum amounts to 3 times in 13 years

Formula used:

Compound interest = Amount - Principal

Amount = P(1+(R)/(100))T

Where P, R and T are principal, rate and time respectively.

Calculation:

Let the sum be P.

Then,

Amount = P(1+(R)/(100))T

⇒ 3P = P(1+(R)/(100))13

⇒ 3 = (1+(R)/(100))13

On squaring both sides, we get:

⇒ (3)² = {(1+(R)/(100))¹³}²

⇒ 9 = (1+(R)/(100))26

Hence, The time required to make the amount 9 times is 26 years.

∴ The Required value of time is 26 years.
